_comment: The map's colours (MM-9). Resource packs can replace this file; F3+T reloads it. Every value is optional: one left out or unreadable keeps the built-in value. Each block shows its real colour: the average of its top texture (from the resource packs) times its biome tint. Keys of the painted look before MM-9 (paper, hillshade, edges, forest, contours, finish, fog, colour, height_tint, snow, the old water keys) are ignored.
_classes: optional overrides: classes 0-7 are grass, forest floor, sand, rock, snow, dirt/mud, ice, lava. A class given a 'colour' shows in it instead of its blocks' real colours, tinted by the biome's grass or foliage colour as much as its 'tint' says (0 none, 1 fully). None is set by default, e.g. "classes": { "3": { "colour": "#9c978d", "tint": 0 } }
_shading: how strong the height shading is (0 off, 1 normal, 2 double): each block against its north and west neighbours, higher lighter, lower darker, in a few clear steps
_water: the floor shows through the water: opacity: how much of the water's own colour (its biome's) lies over the floor a block deep (0-1); depth: the depth in blocks at which the floor no longer shows; darken: how much darker the water is at that depth (0-0.9)
